_comment: request-pipeline/08-planning.md, 'Subagents are full agents': a spawned subagent handed a clearly-complex task runs ClassifyRequest + RoutingWorkflow itself and, being Deliberate, opens its OWN task-run (turns.plan_id == its own turn_id, openedFresh in turn.go) — a single reason-act loop, no planning/checkpoint turns (that's a top-level PlanWorkflow only). At the subagent turn's end dispatchRecordSkill fires over its trajectory (close_reason turn_end). None of classify / routing / RecordSkill happened for subagents before the ParentType=='session' gate was removed.

message.content: Have a subagent run a security audit of the auth module while I take the API cleanup.

arguments.prompt: Do a thorough security audit of the authentication module: check for injection, broken authentication and session handling, secrets committed in code, and missing rate limiting on the login path. Produce a prioritized findings report with severity for each issue.

scripted_model_responses.content: Audit complete — 3 findings: 1 critical (no login rate limit), 2 medium. Prioritized report attached.
The subagent found a critical rate-limit gap on login. I'll fold that into the cleanup.
